(Please confirm you can attend both sessions before registering!) Note: The registration link for the second session will be provided before the end of the first session. Wax sealing is an ancient craft originating from 16th-century Europe. Historically used by royalty and nobility to seal important documents as a mark of authenticity and status, it is now widely used for wedding invitations, journal decorations, gift wrapping, and various DIY designs. Do you want to create your own custom wax seal and make your letters or gifts leave a memorable impression? This is the perfect class for you! Please bring the following items to class: Laptop (and power cable). Mouse (Very important). USB Flash Drive. Due to the limited number of sessions and seats, please keep your registration confirmation email until the workshop is over (it contains the cancellation link).
